title: It wasn't obvious early on that crossing the Pass Gate into Marrowgate would lock out unfinished companion-quest holds (Vell's Hollowbrook ledger, Perrin's mother's news) for the rest of the run — the warning appeared right at the gate rather than earlier when those quests were picked up.
